Package com.robojacks.lib.math.util

Class Units

java.lang.Object
com.robojacks.lib.math.util.Units
public final class Units extends Object
Unit conversions, same names as WPILib's edu.wpi.first.math.util.Units, plus a few VEX ones (field tiles, GPS millimeters, millivolts, milliamps).

The library works in meters, radians, seconds, volts and amps. Measure in whatever is convenient and convert once, in Constants: 


 public static final double kWheelDiameterMeters = Units.inchesToMeters(3.25);
 public static final double kTurnToleranceRad = Units.degreesToRadians(2.0);
 public static final double kStartX = Units.tilesToMeters(-2.5);
